item.description:
### Websites: "Allow only these sites"
- Block lists have a new mode: allow only the websites you list, and block every other site in your browsers. Apps on the list stay blocked. - Organisations and parents can now set "Allow only these sites" for a Mac too, and the Blocker shows which sites are allowed. - A site your organisation blocks can no longer be reopened by an exception on one of your own lists.
### Organisations
- A Mac managed by an organisation is covered by the organisation's plan: no more "Get PRO" on its protection cards, and every card works.
### Also in this update
- A redesigned upgrade screen that leads with the free trial. - Risky Words uses the reviewed word lists, and hides its count when off. - Parent-mode edits on a child's Mac to Mindful Pause and guards now match what the parent's phone shows. - More of the app is translated into all 11 languages.
